description.value: 75 West Coast Grill is a full-service restaurant inside the Vancouver Airport Marriott Hotel in Richmond, specializing in flavour-forward West Coast dishes alongside a curated selection of BC wines and local craft beers. The modern, cozy space features bar and lounge seating, and the restaurant regularly hosts live music nights, wine pairing dinners, and weekend brunch specials. It sits along Westminster Highway in the YVR corridor, a part of Richmond that is accessible by bicycle.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 29m; rack at 46m; rack (covered) at 65m.
